name: Theme slots when the tool opens
step: Check that a hosted tool writes the radio's theme slots after init and before its first build
rationale: Opened from the dashboard, the tool's init is one widget call under the instruction limit and the heaviest of the open; the theme slots are written on the pass after it, on a pass of their own, and the first build waits for them so nothing is drawn in the radio's colours. This loads the real ui/home.lua on the accounting stubs.
